card_b.description: An issuer-assigned number that identifies a cardholder's account. This transaction must contain the same Account Number as the original to which it applies. Acquirer Note: This field may contain the Token for x5, x6, TCQ 0 transactions.

card_a.name: Account Number Extension
card_a.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If the account number exceeds 16 digits, the extension field entry must be numeric, left-justified, and any remaining positions zero-filled. VIC Edit: The field must contain zeros if Account Number is 16 digits or fewer. Outgoing: The Edit Package inserts zeros if the Account Number is 16 digits or fewer in length, according to the ARDEF Table. If the Account Number is greater than 16 digits in length, the processing center must fill this field.

card_b.name: Account Number Extension
card_b.description: A three-digit extension of the account number that allows account numbers up to 19 digits. If the account number exceeds 16 digits, the extension field entry must be numeric, left-justified, and any remaining positions zero-filled. VIC Edit: The field must contain zeros if Account Number is 16 digits or fewer. Outgoing: The Edit Package inserts zeros if the Account Number is 16 digits or fewer in length, according to the ARDEF Table. If the Account Number is greater than 16 digits in length, the processing center must fill this field.

card_a.description: The format code is part of the Acquirer Reference Number and is used to ensure a valid Visa reference number. The entry must be either a 2 or a 7.

card_b.name: Format Code
card_b.description: The format code is part of the Acquirer Reference Number and is used to ensure a valid Visa reference number. The entry must be either a 2 or a 7.

card_a.name: Acquirer Reference Number (ARN)
card_a.description: Identification number assigned by the acquirer. The ARN should be unique although duplicate ARNs will not be rejected. This field must contain the Acquirer Reference Number from the dispute financial or dispute response financial. The Acquirer Reference Number must be the same as the original transaction. The entry must be in the following format.

card_b.name: Acquirer Reference Number (ARN)
card_b.description: Identification number assigned by the acquirer. The ARN should be unique although duplicate ARNs will not be rejected. This field must contain the Acquirer Reference Number from the dispute financial or dispute response financial. The Acquirer Reference Number must be the same as the original transaction. The entry must be in the following format.

card_a.name: Acquiring Identifier
card_a.description: A numeric used to identify an acquiring financial institution. The entry must be a valid acquiring identifier per the current BIN Table. May be an issuing identifier for cash disbursements

card_b.name: Acquiring Identifier
card_b.description: A numeric used to identify an acquiring financial institution. The entry must be a valid acquiring identifier per the current BIN Table. May be an issuing identifier for cash disbursements

card_a.name: Date
card_a.description: Date is part of the Acquirer Reference Number and should be either the data capture date or the pre-edit program run date. The date field must contain a valid four-digit numeric in the format YDDD (year and Julian day).

card_b.name: Date
card_b.description: Date is part of the Acquirer Reference Number and should be either the data capture date or the pre-edit program run date. The date field must contain a valid four-digit numeric in the format YDDD (year and Julian day).

card_a.name: Film Locator
card_a.description: Number used to identify film records. The field must contain an 11-digit numeric. The entry may be zeros if the center has other provisions for quick retrieval of originals/photocopies.

card_b.name: Film Locator
card_b.description: Number used to identify film records. The field must contain an 11-digit numeric. The entry may be zeros if the center has other provisions for quick retrieval of originals/photocopies.

card_a.name: Check Digit
card_a.description: Check Digit is used to validate the Acquirer Reference Number. The entry must be a valid standard modulus-10 check digit of the preceding 22 digits (Positions 24-45).

card_b.name: Check Digit
card_b.description: Check Digit is used to validate the Acquirer Reference Number. The entry must be a valid standard modulus-10 check digit of the preceding 22 digits (Positions 24-45).

card_a.name: Acquirer's Business ID
card_a.description: The Visa-assigned business ID provided in the original by the acquirer. U.S. issuers must retain and return this field in retrieval requests if it was provided by the acquirer.

card_b.name: Acquirer's Business ID
card_b.description: The Visa-assigned business ID provided in the original by the acquirer. U.S. issuers must retain and return this field in retrieval requests if it was provided by the acquirer.

card_a.name: Purchase Date
card_a.description: The date a cardholder made the original purchase (the actual date of the original transaction). The entry must be a four-digit numeric (which may be zeros) in the format MMDD (month and day). This field may contain zeros. If it is not all zeros, the format is MMDD. This field may be all zeros only if the date from the original transaction was all zeros.

card_b.name: Purchase Date
card_b.description: The date a cardholder made the original purchase (the actual date of the original transaction). The entry must be a four-digit numeric (which may be zeros) in the format MMDD (month and day). This field may contain zeros. If it is not all zeros, the format is MMDD. This field may be all zeros only if the date from the original transaction was all zeros.

card_a.name: Transaction Amount
card_a.description: The total amount of the transaction -- between a cardholder and a merchant, or between a cardholder and a client. For U.S. transactions, this field must be numeric and greater than zero. For non-U.S. transactions, this field may contain zeros if the Merchant Name and Country Code are provided. For both U.S. and international transactions, this should be the same as the original Transaction Amount in the transaction currency (the amount in the Source Amount field of the original transaction). This field contains two implied decimal places.

card_b.name: Transaction Amount
card_b.description: The total amount of the transaction -- between a cardholder and a merchant, or between a cardholder and a client. For U.S. transactions, this field must be numeric and greater than zero. For non-U.S. transactions, this field may contain zeros if the Merchant Name and Country Code are provided. For both U.S. and international transactions, this should be the same as the original Transaction Amount in the transaction currency (the amount in the Source Amount field of the original transaction). This field contains two implied decimal places.

card_a.name: Transaction Currency Code
card_a.description: This field contains the three-digit currency code of the transaction. See the appropriate VisaNet user’s manuals for the listing of valid currency codes. For U.S. transactions, this must be a valid ISO numeric code. For international transactions, this field may contain spaces if the Merchant Name and Country Code are provided. Otherwise, it must be a valid ISO numeric code. For both U.S. and international transactions, this is the original transaction amount currency code (Source Currency Code field of the original transaction).

card_b.name: Transaction Currency Code
card_b.description: This field contains the three-digit currency code of the transaction. See the appropriate VisaNet user’s manuals for the listing of valid currency codes. For U.S. transactions, this must be a valid ISO numeric code. For international transactions, this field may contain spaces if the Merchant Name and Country Code are provided. Otherwise, it must be a valid ISO numeric code. For both U.S. and international transactions, this is the original transaction amount currency code (Source Currency Code field of the original transaction).

It may be omitted if the Transaction Amount and Transaction Currency Code are provided. For international transactions, this field must be the same as in the original transaction, except when a discrepancy or omission in a TC 52 transaction makes it impossible to locate the document requested. In this instance, the acquirer center must identify the problem in this field and send a TC 53 back to the requestor.

The format of this field is SSRRRRRR, where: SS = Scale Factor. These positions represent the number of digits to the right of the decimal point in the currency conversion rate field. The first two positions will be 00 through 12. RRRRRR = Conversion Rate A scale factor of zero means the entry is a whole number. l A scale factor of 01 means the number has one decimal place l accuracy: RRRRR.R is entered as 01RRRRRR. A scale factor of 02 means the number has two decimal places l accuracy: RRRR.RR is entered as 02RRRRRR, and so forth. For a scale factor greater than 6, as many leading zeros as necessary l should be inserted; for example, .00RRRRRR is entered as 08RRRRRR.

card_a.name: Buy Scale Factor and Rate
card_a.description: The currency scale factor identifier for each of the conversion rates. The number of units of base currency required to buy one unit of counter currency. The format of this field is SSRRRRRR where: SS = Scale Factor. These positions represent number of digits to the right of the decimal point in the currency conversion rate field. The first two positions will be 00 through 12. RRRRRR = Conversion Rate. A scale factor of zeros means the entry is a whole number. l A scale factor of 01 means the number has one decimal place l accuracy; RRRRR.R is entered as 01RRRRRR. A scale factor of 02 means the number has two decimal places l accuracy: RRRR.RR is entered as 02RRRRRR and so forth. For a scale factor greater than 6, as many leading zeros as necessary l should be inserted; for example, .00RRRRRR is entered as 08RRRRRR

card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_b.name: Transaction Code Qualifier
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero). This edit will continue to be performed by the Edit Package when the Bypass Business Edits option is used during an outgoing edit run.

card_a.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_b.name: Transaction Component Sequence Number
card_b.description: The field must contain a 0 (zero).

card_a.name: Destination Identifier
card_a.description: The entity to which a BASE II transaction message is sent. The field must contain a valid acquiring identifier with a relationship with the data capture service provider.

card_b.name: Destination Identifier
card_b.description: The entity to which a BASE II transaction message is sent. The field must contain a valid acquiring identifier with a relationship with the data capture service provider.

card_a.name: Source Identifier
card_a.description: The field must contain the source identifier of the data capture service provider.

card_b.description: The field must contain the source identifier of the data capture service provider.

card_b.name: Reserved
card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.name: Transaction Amount
card_a.description: The total amount of the transaction - between a cardholder and a merchant, or between a cardholder and a client. The transaction amount includes the actual amount of the purchase plus state (or other) taxes. This field must contain zeros.

card_b.name: Transaction Amount
card_b.description: The total amount of the transaction - between a cardholder and a merchant, or between a cardholder and a client. The transaction amount includes the actual amount of the purchase plus state (or other) taxes. This field must contain zeros.

card_a.name: Reserved
card_a.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_b.name: Reserved
card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.name: Draft Flag
card_a.description: Indicates if draft submitted. This field may contain any alphanumeric value. N = No draft submitted (default).

card_b.name: Draft Flag
card_b.description: Indicates if draft submitted. This field may contain any alphanumeric value. N = No draft submitted (default).

card_a.name: Central Processing Date
card_a.description: The date (based on Greenwich mean time) on which a client enters Interchange data to, and the data is accepted by, a VisaNet Interchange Center (VIC). Same as BASE II Collection Date. Outgoing: The field must be a numeric. Incoming: The field will contain a valid YDDD (year and Julian day) date.

card_b.name: Central Processing Date
card_b.description: The date (based on Greenwich mean time) on which a client enters Interchange data to, and the data is accepted by, a VisaNet Interchange Center (VIC). Same as BASE II Collection Date. Outgoing: The field must be a numeric. Incoming: The field will contain a valid YDDD (year and Julian day) date.

card_a.description: Identifies the type of data in this record. The field must contain DC.

card_b.name: Record Format Code
card_b.description: Identifies the type of data in this record. The field must contain DC.

card_a.description: Indicates if this is a reversal. The field must be space-filled or contain an R. Blank = Nonreversal (default) R = Reversal

card_b.name: Reversal Flag
card_b.description: Indicates if this is a reversal. The field must be space-filled or contain an R. Blank = Nonreversal (default) R = Reversal

card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.description: Date TC 57 created. The format for this field is YDDD (Julian Date). This date cannot be greater than the Edit Package processing date.

card_b.name: Data Capture Processing Date
card_b.description: Date TC 57 created. The format for this field is YDDD (Julian Date). This date cannot be greater than the Edit Package processing date.

card_b.description: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

card_a.name: Agent
card_a.description: Indicates the settlement agent bank. This field should contain the name of the agent initially accepting the payment. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero. If not zero, provides a level of reporting between acquiring identifier and chain.

card_b.name: Agent
card_b.description: Indicates the settlement agent bank. This field should contain the name of the agent initially accepting the payment. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero. If not zero, provides a level of reporting between acquiring identifier and chain.

card_a.name: Chain
card_a.description: Indicates name of merchant chain. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero. If not zero, provides a level of reporting between acquiring identifier and chain.

card_b.name: Chain
card_b.description: Indicates name of merchant chain. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero. If not zero, provides a level of reporting between acquiring identifier and chain.

card_a.name: Merchant Number
card_a.description: Number identifying the merchant. The field must be numeric and greater than zero. 15 digits after one leading zero, or 12 digits after four leading zeros. Cannot be all zeros.

card_b.name: Merchant Number
card_b.description: Number identifying the merchant. The field must be numeric and greater than zero. 15 digits after one leading zero, or 12 digits after four leading zeros. Cannot be all zeros.

card_a.name: Store Number
card_a.description: Number identifying the merchant location where the transaction took place. Assigned by acquirer. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero.

card_b.name: Store Number
card_b.description: Number identifying the merchant location where the transaction took place. Assigned by acquirer. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero.

card_a.name: Terminal Number
card_a.description: Number identifying the actual terminal involved in a given transaction. Assigned by acquirer. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero.

card_b.name: Terminal Number
card_b.description: Number identifying the actual terminal involved in a given transaction. Assigned by acquirer. The field must be numeric and may contain a zero.

card_a.name: Merchant Batch Number
card_a.description: Number assigned by the merchant terminal identifying a particular set of transaction records. The field must be numeric and greater than zero.

card_b.name: Merchant Batch Number
card_b.description: Number assigned by the merchant terminal identifying a particular set of transaction records. The field must be numeric and greater than zero.

card_a.name: Merchant Batch Date
card_a.description: Date on which merchant transmitted the batch to the VIC. The format of this field is MMDD.

card_b.name: Merchant Batch Date
card_b.description: Date on which merchant transmitted the batch to the VIC. The format of this field is MMDD.

card_a.name: Discover Merchant ID
card_a.description: Identification number of merchant dealing with Discover cards. The field must be numeric and greater than zero if the terminal can collect Discover transactions. Otherwise, it must contain spaces.

card_b.name: Discover Merchant ID

The U.S. Postal Service standard city abbreviations as provided in the appropriate VisaNet user manuals must be used for city names containing more than 13 characters. The merchant city as shown in the original presentment must be included in all dispute financial, retrieval requests, and dispute response financial. The first position of the field may not be a space. For American Express, Merchant City should be placed here and in the Service Establishment City field on TCR 1.

card_b.name: Merchant City
card_b.description: The city location of the merchant or client outlet where the transaction occurred. The U.S. Postal Service standard city abbreviations as provided in the appropriate VisaNet user manuals must be used for city names containing more than 13 characters. The merchant city as shown in the original presentment must be included in all dispute financial, retrieval requests, and dispute response financial. The first position of the field may not be a space. For American Express, Merchant City should be placed here and in the Service Establishment City field on TCR 1.

card_a.name: Merchant State/Province Code

card_b.name: Merchant State/Province Code
card_b.description: Code designating merchant's state or province code. If the Merchant Country Code is U.S., this field must contain a valid U.S. State Code; otherwise, it must contain spaces.

card_a.name: Merchant Country Code
card_a.description: The entry must be that of the country where the Visa transaction occurred, regardless of the location of entry to the system. The field is critical for the proper processing of all transactions. It is one of the criteria for definition of an international transaction, which affects editing of other fields, reimbursement fee calculations, and BASE II processing charges. The field must contain a valid Country Code. For non-Visa transactions, it must be U.S.

card_b.name: Merchant Country Code

card_a.name: Electronic Terminal Indicator
card_a.description: Indicates whether an electronic terminal was used in the transaction. An electronic terminal is a point-of-sale (POS) terminal, an automated teller machine (ATM), or a cash dispensing machine used at the point of transaction to generate electronic impulses that are captured in computer-readable form for the initiation of paper. The field must contain a zero or a 1.

card_a.name: Continuation Tape Indicator
card_a.description: Indicates this is the first file of multiple files. Header records are used to identify the file. Clients can receive more than one delivery file during one processing cycle. This can occur under two different conditions. The multiple files may be continuation files of one transmission. In this case, the Continuation Tape Indicator in the TC 90s of the first file would contain a space, and that field in the TC 90s of following files would contain a C (indicating continuation). The File Continuation Count Field on all TC 92s except the last would contain 000000; the TC 92 of the last file would contain the number of files in the transmission. These files may also be multiple separate files with no continuation relationship. This would, for example, occur when customized delivery services have been selected. In this case the Continuation Tape Indicator in the TC 90s on the files will be set to a space. The File Continuation Count field on each of the TC 92s would contain 000001. This field must contain a space. For client endpoints that send files directly to VisaNet without an Edit Package, this field is not used and must be set to spaces.

card_a.name: Continuation Tape Indicator
card_a.description: Indicates this is the first file of multiple files. Header records are used to identify the file. Clients can receive more than one delivery file during one processing cycle. This can occur under two different conditions. The multiple files may be continuation files of one transmission. In this case, the Continuation Tape Indicator in the TC 90s of the first file would contain a space, and that field in the TC 90s of following files would contain a C (indicating continuation). The File Continuation Count Field on all TC 92s except the last would contain 000000; the TC 92 of the last file would contain the number of files in the transmission. These files may also be multiple separate files with no continuation relationship. This would, for example, occur when customized delivery services have been selected. In this case the Continuation Tape Indicator in the TC 90s on the files will be set to a space. The File Continuation Count field on each of the TC 92s would contain 000001. This field must contain a space or a C (Continuation of transmission). The field must contain a C if the File Continuation Count field on the previous TC 92 is zeros. For more information about this field, see the explanation of Multiple File Delivery.
card_a.note: For Visa use.

card_a.name: Settlement Date
